title: Request to DEA for an exception to a chapter provision
rule_summary: Any person may apply for an exception to the application of any provision of 21 CFR chapter II by filing a written request with the Office of Diversion Control, Drug Enforcement Administration, stating the reasons for the exception. The Administrator may grant an exception in his discretion, but in no case shall he or she be required to grant an exception to any person which is otherwise required by law or the regulations cited in that section.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate knows that a federal provision stating no exception of its own can still be the subject of a discretionary request, and that the request is not a right to relief.
common_confusions: The provision creates a route to ask, not an entitlement: the Administrator may grant an exception in his discretion.
verification_notes: Read in the current eCFR text of 21 CFR 1307.03 on ecfr.gov on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed. A fresh independent audit is still required before any section relying on it is published.
